name: leave_mgmt_new

scripts.db:repair: ts-node -e "require('./src/scripts/syncEssentialData').fixMigrationsTable().then(() => console.log('Migrations table fixed')).catch((err) => { console.error(err); process.exit(1); })" && npm run run:migrations
scripts.ensure:default-users: ts-node -e "require('./src/utils/ensure-default-users').ensureDefaultUsers().then(() => console.log('Default users check completed')).catch((err) => { console.error(err); process.exit(1); })"
scripts.init:approval-workflows: ts-node -e "require('./src/scripts/syncEssentialData').runInitApprovalWorkflows().then(() => console.log('Approval workflows initialized')).catch((err) => { console.error(err); process.exit(1); })"
scripts.db:fresh: npm run db:reset && npm run dev
scripts.check:leave-type: ts-node -e "const args = process.argv.slice(2); if(!args[0]) { console.error('Please provide a leave type ID'); process.exit(1); } require('./src/scripts/syncEssentialData').checkSpecificLeaveType(args[0]).then(() => process.exit(0)).catch((err) => { console.error(err); process.exit(1); })"
scripts.check:leave-balances: ts-node -e "const args = process.argv.slice(2); if(!args[0]) { console.error('Please provide a leave type ID'); process.exit(1); } const year = args[1] ? parseInt(args[1]) : undefined; require('./src/scripts/syncEssentialData').checkLeaveTypeBalances(args[0], year).then(() => process.exit(0)).catch((err) => { console.error(err); process.exit(1); })"
scripts.check:essential-data: ts-node -e "require('./src/scripts/syncEssentialData').checkEssentialData().then(() => console.log('Essential data check completed')).catch((err) => { console.error(err); process.exit(1); })"
scripts.deploy: git add . && git commit -m "Server deployment commit" && git push origin main
scripts.deploy:staging: git add . && git commit -m "Server staging deployment" && git push origin staging
scripts.deploy:prod: npm run build && git add . && git commit -m "Server production deployment" && git push origin production

description: A comprehensive leave management system built with Hapi.js, TypeORM, and PostgreSQL.
